metadata.description: A comprehensive CPFD model of a drinking water treatment facility showing the complete treatment process from intake through distribution, including SCADA control systems, physical infrastructure, and trust boundaries.

elements.name: Water Source
elements.description: Natural water source providing raw untreated water to the facility intake system

elements.name: Landfill
elements.description: Waste disposal site receiving plant waste including sludge, sediment, and filter residue

elements.name: Water Distribution Network
elements.description: Municipal water distribution infrastructure delivering treated water to consumers

elements.name: Onsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Plant operators physically present at the facility who interact with SCADA systems and physical infrastructure

elements.name: Electric Utility Provider
elements.description: External electric utility providing power to the treatment facility

elements.name: Offsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Remote plant operators accessing SCADA systems via network connections

elements.name: Org Intranet
elements.description: Organization's internal network infrastructure

elements.name: Internet
elements.description: Global internet providing external connectivity

elements.name: Drinking Water Treatment Facility
elements.description: Primary facility perimeter trust boundary encompassing all treatment processes and control systems

elements.name: Post-treatment shed
elements.description: Physically secured structure housing post-treatment chemical dosing equipment

elements.name: Electrical shed
elements.description: Physically secured structure housing main power distribution infrastructure

elements.name: Coagulant/Flocculant
elements.description: Chemical storage for coagulation and flocculation agents used in water treatment

elements.name: Sediment
elements.description: Collected sediment and sludge from sedimentation process

elements.name: Chemical Disinfectant
elements.description: Chemical storage for disinfection agents (chlorine, UV, etc.)

elements.name: Post Chemical
elements.description: Chemical storage for post-treatment conditioning agents

elements.name: Water Storage
elements.description: Final storage tank for treated water before distribution

elements.name: Intake
elements.description: Water intake process with automated gates, screens, and pumps controlled by PLC actuators and monitored by RTU sensors

elements.name: Coagulation/Flocculation
elements.description: Chemical treatment process mixing coagulants with water to destabilize particles, controlled by PLC actuators and monitored by RTU sensors

elements.name: Sedimentation
elements.description: Settling process where flocculated particles settle out of water, controlled by PLC actuators and monitored by RTU sensors

elements.name: Filtration
elements.description: Multi-layer filtration process removing remaining particles and microorganisms, controlled by PLC actuators and monitored by RTU sensors

elements.name: Disinfection
elements.description: Chemical and/or UV disinfection to inactivate remaining pathogens, controlled by PLC actuators and monitored by RTU sensors

elements.name: Chemical Posttreatment
elements.description: Final chemical conditioning of treated water for pH adjustment and corrosion control

elements.name: Waste collection and disposal
elements.description: Collection and transport of sludge, sediment, and filter residue for disposal

elements.description: Physical tank structure for coagulation and flocculation reactions

elements.name: Sedimentation Tank
elements.description: Physical basin for gravity settling of flocculated particles

elements.description: Physical filter vessel containing multi-layer filtration media

elements.name: Disinfection Tank
elements.description: Physical contact chamber for chemical disinfection and UV treatment
